targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(quality_score) as score FROM data_quality_checks WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

SELECT CASE WHEN quality_score >= 85 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN quality_score >= 70 THEN 'Good' WHEN quality_score >= 50 THEN 'Fair' ELSE 'Poor' END as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM data_quality_checks WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY level
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as time, AVG(quality_score) as score FROM data_quality_checks WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
